label: v9: sliding round hood + rolling extension
describe: Fixed trough hood slides level for NECTAR on a dead-centre crank; an extension rolls up the same circle for flatter shots; the ball is lifted from the carousel cell and caught by two sprung side wheels geared to the flywheel, then rides a fixed front ramp into the pinch. Everything sits on the ring gear.

label: v8: low flywheel, fed up the bore
describe: Flywheel over the bore (axle 128 mm above the turret plate). The ball rides up a 94 mm bore; the hood's straight tail meets the bore edge at the steepest POLLEN setting and its 3 fingers slide back through the static comb's gaps for NECTAR. Collision shapes = the CAD's shapes. Jitter on: the ball arrives anywhere in the bore (sideways too) at +/-10 % speed.

label: Proposal
describe: Hogbacks + 3 steel discs per side, polycarbonate hood, 16:24 belt.

label: No steel discs
describe: Lighter flywheel: drops more speed per shot, recovers just as fast.

label: 1 steel disc per side
describe: Lighter flywheel: 1 steel disc per side.

label: 2 steel discs per side
describe: Lighter flywheel: 2 steel discs per side.

label: Hood 4 mm closer to the wheel
describe: The hood's arc built 4 mm smaller: tighter pinch.

label: Hood 4 mm further from the wheel
describe: The hood's arc built 4 mm larger: looser pinch.

label: Aluminium hood
describe: Same hood shape in aluminium: different grip and bounce on the ball.

label: 24:24 belt (wheel at motor speed)
describe: Motor and wheel turn at the same speed: less torque to hold the wheel's speed.

label: Team turret draft (spring loaded)
describe: The team's first draft, read from its STEP: fixed exit angle (~56 deg), sprung hood on slotted carriers. Spring, motor drive and hood rest position are ESTIMATES.
